changelog: New Config.PickupSettings. You can now decide who is allowed to pick a hookah up and carry it away, by job or by group, the same way Config.DeleteBoxSettings already works. Perfect for a lounge where guests may smoke but only your staff may move the hookahs.
Players who are not allowed to pick up or delete a hookah no longer see the option at all, in every supported target system and in the key prompts.
Job and group changes now apply straight away, without the player having to relog.
New fx-hookah:server:onSmoke event and three new exports, so you can give every tobacco its own metabolism or status effect from your own resource. See the new EXPORTS.md.
Picking up, putting down and smoking are now checked on the server, which closes an exploit where a hookah could be taken or used from anywhere on the map.
Fixed a hookah becoming invisible until the next restart when the player carrying it disconnected.
Fixed hookahs and permissions sometimes not loading when a character was still being loaded.
updateFiles: config.lua new Locale pickup_disabled and pickup_no_permission
